entries.en: So you two're gettin' along fine?
entries.ro: Deci voi doi vă înțelegeți bine?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ… どうかな… よくわからない…" t="I... I guess so... I don't even know..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="さあ… どうかな… よくわからない…" t="Eu... Cred că da... Nici nu știu..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Too ordinary for you, huh? Gettin' bored already?
entries.ro: Prea obișnuit pentru tine, huh? Te-ai plictisit deja?

entries.en: So what's his deal? Not enough of an asshole, violent drunk, gaslighting psycho, or--
entries.ro: Deci care-i problema lui? Nu-i destul de nesimțit, bețiv violent, nebun manipulator sau--

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何よ、あたしがおかしいって言いたいの？" t="Maybe I'm a psycho too, huh?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何よ、あたしがおかしいって言いたいの？" t="Poate sunt și eu psihopată, huh?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だからロクな男ができない。そういうこと？" t="Maybe I just get what I deserve, is that it?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だからロクな男ができない。そういうこと？" t="Poate primesc doar ce merit, nu-i așa?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Hey, cut that shit out. I didn't mean to...
entries.ro: Hei, lasă căcaturile astea. N-am vrut să...

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ただでさえ最悪な日だったのに、あんたまでそういうこと言うなんて！" t="It's not enough I had a bad day, now YOU have to get on my ass?!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ただでさえ最悪な日だったのに、あんたまでそういうこと言うなんて！" t="Nu-mi ajunge că am avut o zi proastă, acum și TU trebuie să stai pe capul meu?!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: What happened? You wanna talk about it?
entries.ro: Ce s-a întâmplat? Vrei să vorbești despre asta?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="うん… じゃあコーヒーでも飲みに行きましょ…" t="Yeah... let's go get a coffee or something..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="うん… じゃあコーヒーでも飲みに行きましょ…" t="Da... hai să mergem să bem o cafea sau ceva..." b="" a=""/>
